verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is an API-first product. Its documented Jobs API covers creating jobs by URL or upload, reading status and results, auth and health endpoints, webhooks, and SSE streaming. A live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt were probe-confirmed, and a published versioning policy and per-agent API keys are documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of actually driving the Jobs API end-to-end (the probes confirm the docs and spec exist, not that API calls succeed).
